servers.name: jira-mcp
servers.description: Focused MCP server for JiraForge Agent.

servers.name: gitlab-mcp
servers.description: Focused MCP server for GitBridge Agent.

servers.name: test-mcp
servers.description: Focused MCP server for TestPilot Agent.

servers.name: review-mcp
servers.description: Focused MCP server for ReviewSmith Agent.

servers.name: dev-mcp
servers.description: Single-tool MCP server for end-to-end development workflow.

tools.name: dev_plan_feature_stories
tools.description: Learn a Feature end to end, including sprint-wise existing stories, Confluence cache excerpts, repo graph context, missing delivery phases, and the next approval gate before drafting stories.

tools.name: dev_bootstrap_feature_stories
tools.description: Complete Feature bootstrap flow: learn Feature context, discover existing child stories, read Confluence/ADR cache and repo graph, generate BDRSP-1623 story payloads when none exist, require sprint assignment, preview first, and create only after approval.

tools.name: dev_create_feature_stories
tools.description: Preview or create all approved sprint-wise stories for a Feature through DevFlow after feature planning, codebase review, style validation, and explicit confirmation.

tools.name: dev_implement_story
tools.description: Orchestrate Jira story readiness, branch setup, scoped code implementation contract, autonomous test execution (run_tests=true runs mvn/gradle/pytest via subprocess — no IDE terminal needed), review, and approved MR creation.

tools.name: jira_check_connection
tools.description: Validate Jira credentials and return connected user info.

tools.name: jira_read_story
tools.description: Fetch full Jira issue/story details by Jira ID/key.

tools.name: jira_analyze_story
tools.description: Analyze Jira story, ACs, gaps, clearer wording, and next steps.

tools.name: jira_plan_feature_stories
tools.description: Learn a Feature end to end, including sprint-wise existing stories, Confluence cache excerpts, repo graph context, missing delivery phases, and the mandatory story style contract.

tools.name: jira_bootstrap_feature_stories
tools.description: Complete Feature bootstrap flow: learn Feature context, discover existing child stories, read Confluence/ADR cache and repo graph, generate BDRSP-1623 story payloads when none exist, require sprint assignment, preview first, and create only after approval.

tools.name: jira_create_feature_stories
tools.description: Preview or create all approved stories for a Feature after jira_plan_feature_stories, codebase review, style validation, and explicit confirmation.

tools.name: jira_plan_subtasks
tools.description: Suggest minimal subtasks without creating them.

tools.name: jira_refine_story
tools.description: Suggest and optionally apply a professional Jira story title, description, and ACs after approval. Subtasks are suggestion-only.

tools.name: jira_feature_context
tools.description: Read the parent Feature, sibling stories, completed stories, and current story fit before Jira story writing.

tools.name: jira_delete_subtasks
tools.description: Preview and delete Jira subtasks only after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: jira_manage_subtasks
tools.description: Plan and safely create/update Jira subtasks after duplicate checks and explicit per-action approval.

tools.name: gitlab_check_connection
tools.description: Validate GitLab credentials and project access.

tools.name: gitlab_check_token_health
tools.description: Check whether the GitLab token is valid, its expiry date, days remaining, and step-by-step renewal instructions. Call this when any GitLab tool returns 401/403 or when the token might be stale.

tools.name: gitlab_get_merge_request
tools.description: Fetch merge request metadata, branches, reviewers, state, and pipeline summary.

tools.name: gitlab_get_merge_request_changes
tools.description: Fetch changed files and diff metadata for a merge request.

tools.name: gitlab_get_merge_request_discussions
tools.description: Fetch merge request discussions and unresolved thread summary.

tools.name: gitlab_get_pipeline_status
tools.description: Fetch the merge request head pipeline and recent pipeline statuses.

tools.name: gitlab_create_branch
tools.description: Create a local Git branch using the project branch naming convention.

tools.name: gitlab_prepare_merge_request
tools.description: Prepare a professional MR title and description without pushing or creating an MR.

tools.name: gitlab_push_branch
tools.description: Push a branch to GitLab. Defaults to dry-run for safety.

tools.name: gitlab_create_merge_request
tools.description: Create a GitLab merge request through the API without committing or pushing local code.

tools.name: jiraforge_code_updater
tools.description: Prepare a safe Jira story/subtask implementation contract for lightweight code updates.

tools.name: test_detect_project_type
tools.description: Detect the project build/test ecosystem such as Maven, Gradle, Node, Python, Go, or .NET.

tools.name: test_discover_test_commands
tools.description: Discover likely unit, integration, and specific-test commands from project files.

tools.name: test_run_unit_tests
tools.description: Run unit tests using the detected command, or an explicit command when provided.

tools.name: test_run_integration_tests
tools.description: Run integration tests using the detected command, or an explicit command when provided.

tools.name: test_run_specific_test
tools.description: Run one focused test class, file, method, or test target.

tools.name: test_analyze_failures
tools.description: Analyze test failure output or report snippets and explain likely causes.

tools.name: test_collect_test_reports
tools.description: Collect test report file paths and snippets from common report locations.

tools.name: test_generate_test_summary
tools.description: Generate a concise testing report with detected project type, commands, reports, and next steps.

tools.name: test_current_change_report
tools.description: Read current code changes and produce a test scope/report with recommended commands and report evidence.

tools.name: review_inspect_story_implementation
tools.description: Inspect whether the current repo already has code related to a Jira story.

tools.name: review_analyze_current_changes
tools.description: Analyze current Git changes, changed areas, risk signals, commits, and diff stat.

tools.name: review_check_acceptance_criteria_coverage
tools.description: Check whether current changes show signals for each acceptance criterion.

tools.name: review_suggest_improvements
tools.description: Suggest review improvements based on current changes, risks, and AC coverage signals.

tools.name: review_generate_change_summary
tools.description: Generate a consolidated review report for current changes against a Jira story.

tools.name: review_full_current_changes
tools.description: Read current code changes and produce a full review with risks, suggestions, and modern engineering guidance.
